# Frontend design: official Anthropic guidance for distinctive, intentional UI

Curated by Skill Harbor — the official @anthropics frontend-design plugin skill (from the `claude-code` repo): a design-lead playbook for distinctive, intentional UI instead of templated AI-generated defaults. It catalogs the tells of generated design (cream backgrounds with terracotta accents, acid-green on near-black, the SaaS-card kit, all-caps eyebrow labels, "→" on every button), grounds aesthetic choices in the subject matter (a toy for kids is not a finance dashboard), and runs a plan-review-build-critique loop: short design plan (color tokens, type, layout, principles) reviewed against the brief before any code is written, then self-critique with restraint rules (one memorable element, quality floor: responsive, keyboard focus, reduced motion).
